title: 1975-11-05_SECTION_013_20.txt
concise_summary: PKD argues that his February-March 1974 visions did not disclose a past life in ancient Rome but rather an eternal, atemporal 'apocalyptic landscape' that exists outside linear time and will be universally revealed at the Parousia. He develops a theory of anamnesis in which 'memory' can be of present or future realities — the Roman world he perceived is the permanent metaphysical substrate concealed beneath contemporary 1970s existence by the dokos (illusion-veil). Converging from two independent lines of reasoning — the 'St. Sophia' utterance he received and his sense that the scale of divine intervention exceeded his personal situation — he concludes that the overthrow of the Nixon-era tyranny in 1974 was the Elijah-stage forerunner clearing the way for the imminent Second Coming of the rightful King.
key_claims: The Rome PKD experienced in 2-3-74 is not a past-life memory but an eternal, atemporal apocalyptic landscape that persists unchanged beneath the contemporary world, concealed by the dokos.
Linear time does not exist in the real (eternal) world; the Second Coming and the First Advent are therefore temporally identical events separated only by the veil of appearance.
Memory can be anamnesis of present or future realities, not merely recollection of past events — PKD's Roman visions constituted memory of what currently IS, not what was.
The 'St. Sophia' utterance he received reveals that the Nixonian tyranny's fall in 1974 was not the totality of the divine plan but only its first stage, to be followed by the Parousia.
The spirit that visited PKD in 1974 was Elijah / John the Baptist — fierce, earthy, a baptizer — returning before the Parousia as prophesied.
Reality is steganographic: the golden fish necklace triggered recognition of a concealed true reality, just as the Bible is an analog encoding hidden meaning.
recurring_concepts: Dokos — the veil or illusion that conceals the eternal apocalyptic landscape from ordinary perception
Parousia — the imminent Second Coming of Christ as the culminating event PKD's visions foretold
Apocalyptic landscape — the eternal, atemporal realm of AD 70 Rome that underlies the present world
Anamnesis / atemporal memory — the capacity to 'remember' present or future realities rather than past events
Orthogonal / vertical time — the eternal world breaches the linear world on a vertical axis, not along the horizontal timeline
Steganography of reality — reality conceals its true structure just as the Bible encodes hidden meaning
Elijah-stage / forerunner — the prophetic role PKD assigns to his 1974 experience as preparation for the Parousia
Sons of light vs. sons of darkness — the Qumran-derived dualistic framework for the cosmic struggle revealed at the Parousia
people_entities: Christ / Jesus — the returning rightful King whose Second Coming is imminent
Elijah — Hebrew prophet who never died; PKD identifies the spirit that came to him in 1974 as Elijah
John the Baptist — Elijah reincarnated as the forerunner of Jesus; killed by Romans; PKD equates with the spirit he received
Elisha — Hebrew prophet, successor to Elijah; appeared in PKD's dreams
Nixon — identified as Ahab figure / the usurper tyrant overthrown in 1974
Tom Disch — science fiction writer; PKD says he knew the spirit's identity when talking with Disch
Moby Dick — PKD identifies himself with Moby Dick in the Bradbury/Ahab framework
King Ahab — biblical tyrant; paired with Elijah; Nixon's analogue in PKD's schema
McCoy (Dr. Leonard) — Star Trek character referenced in the 'Depression' episode PKD is watching
3-eyed sibyl — the visionary figure from whom PKD received the 'St. Sophia' utterance
texts_works: The Bible — described as an analog of reality, steganographic in structure
Star Trek — PKD is watching the 'Depression' episode ('Adjustment Team') while writing; references time-travel plot about changing the past
Moby Dick (Herman Melville) — Bradbury-program framing: Ahab vs. Moby Dick, Elijah vs. King Ahab
autobiographical: PKD describes experiencing a vision of Rome in February-March 1974 (2-3-74) which he is here reinterpreting as apocalyptic landscape rather than past-life memory
He received a 'St. Sophia' utterance — an auditory communication he took to be an answer to his question 'Why?' — during the 1974 experiences
He dreamed three times about Mt. Carmel, Elisha, and Elias around the time of his 1974 visions, which occurred near Easter and Passover
He had a conversation with Tom Disch after which he became certain about the identity of the spirit that visited him
He drew a sign identifying himself with Moby Dick
He is currently watching Star Trek while writing this entry and connects its plot (time travelers from the future changing the past) to his theology of retrograde historical change
He describes knowing Koine Greek, which he offers as evidence that the golden fish necklace triggered genuine suppressed memory rather than mere suggestibility
theological_motifs: Parousia — Greek for 'presence' or 'arrival'; the Second Coming of Christ
Dokos — appearance or illusion; the veil concealing eternal reality
Anamnesis — recollection as mystical participation in eternal truth
Day of Judgment / goats and sheep — the revelation of each person's true position in the cosmic struggle
Sons of light vs. sons of darkness — Qumran / Dead Sea Scrolls dualistic eschatology
Elijah as forerunner — the prophetic tradition that Elijah must return before the Messiah
The still small voice — Elijah's theophany on Mt. Horeb (1 Kings 19)
Baptism / baptizing spirit — the prophetic role of John the Baptist as water-purifier before the Kingdom
Sophia / Holy Wisdom — divine feminine wisdom; the 'St. Sophia' utterance points to Parousia
Supralunar forces — divine agencies operating above the lunar sphere that intervened in history in 1974
Sub specie aeternitatis — eternal vantage point from which positions in the cosmic struggle are already fixed
Steganography of scripture — the Bible as a concealed encoding of true reality
literary_self_ref: PKD explicitly references his novel TEARS (Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said): 'the secret police; they were just seen under a different aspect; they were there anyhow, as the Enemy entrapping (as in TEARS; remember TEARS in this exegesis)' — connecting the novel's Roman police analogue to the eternal apocalyptic landscape

The reference to 'Adjustment Team' (the Star Trek episode based on his own story of that name) is implicit in his watching the episode about time travelers changing the past — he connects the HS moving retrograde to alter history with the premise of that story
symbols_images: The golden fish necklace — ichthys symbol worn by a pharmacy assistant that triggered PKD's anamnesis in 2-3-74
The 3-eyed sibyl — the visionary figure PKD received the 'St. Sophia' communication from
The veil / dokos rolling back — the Parousia as an unveiling that will reveal everyone's true position on the eternal landscape
Goats and sheep — Matthew 25 eschatological sorting of humanity at judgment
The changling on the raft — PKD's self-image from birth as connected to Elijah's spirit
Mt. Carmel — site of Elijah's contest with the prophets of Baal; appeared in PKD's three dreams
Moby Dick — the white whale as self-symbol in the Bradbury / Ahab schema
The fiery zealous spirit — characterized as earthly, prophetic, non-meek; identified as Elijah / John the Baptist
Rome as eternal city — the Roman Empire as permanent ontological landscape beneath the contemporary world
The rightful King — Christ as the legitimate ruler whose throne is currently occupied by the usurper
tensions: PKD oscillates between two explanatory frameworks — past-life memory of an early Christian vs. apocalyptic eternal landscape — and must argue against the former to establish the latter, acknowledging the past-life hypothesis is the 'only alternate theory'

He asks whether Elijah could also be the Holy Spirit, since Elijah never died and ascended to heaven — an unresolved trinitarian puzzle about whether a human prophet can be identified with a divine Person
The claim that PKD has 'always had a part of Elijah's spirit, from birth' sits in tension with the idea that the spirit came to him specifically in 1974 as a visitation

PKD acknowledges that watching a Star Trek episode (a pop-culture artifact) is informing his theology — a tension between his scholarly-visionary self-image and the mundane circumstance of TV-watching as theological catalyst
He is uncertain about the timing: he says the Parousia is imminent ('minutes before') but also hedges that he saw the landscape 'slightly before the Parousia, since the presence is not there yet'
evidence_quotes: Memory is not always of something past; I can remember what I must do tomorrow; I can remember who I am now. This was memory of what is, rather than what was.

The book the Bible is an analog of reality. Perhaps it can be said that I have seen the landscape slightly before the Parousia, since the presence is not there yet (the Xtians I saw were eagerly awaiting the Second Coming). But it is imminent.
Seeing the golden fish triggered off recognition of the true (concealed) reality situation; like the real meaning of the Bible, reality is stegenographic — concealed.

The 'St. Sophia' statement is also important for a reason I hadn't realized: it means that what I saw —the overthrow of the tyranny— was not all that the supralunar forces intended, but that it was to be followed by another event, an even greater one: the return of the rightful King.
No matter how I approach it, we wind up with the same conclusion; but if we take different views of the meaning of 3-74, theory peters out.
uncertainty_flags: The 'Bradbury program' reference ('Ahab vs Moby Dick; Elijah vs King Ahab') is unclear — it may refer to a Ray Bradbury television program PKD was watching or had recently seen, but the specific program is not identified

The 'Depression' episode of Star Trek PKD is watching is unusual — no Star Trek episode by that name is known; he may be misremembering or referring to a different series, or the episode title may be a working/alternate title

PKD's claim to know Koine Greek is presented as evidence of genuine anamnesis, but its extent and origin are unclear — he does not explain whether this was acquired knowledge or whether it appeared supernaturally
The '3-eyed sibyl' who delivered the 'St. Sophia' utterance is referenced without explanation of who or what this entity was — a dream figure, a vision, or a person is unclear from context

The phrase 'the changling on the raft' in connection with PKD's identification with Elijah from birth is cryptic — the referent (a dream? a story? a biographical fact?) is not explained in this segment
reading_excerpt: Seeing the golden fish triggered off recognition of the true (concealed) reality situation; like the real meaning of the Bible, reality is stegenographic — concealed.
raw_text: and the retrieved memory is not of an event in linear time but of an absolute event on an absolute landscape, which penetrated our landscape on a vertical axis, bringing —and this is a superlative insight— absolute events into our relative universe. Those ab¬ solute events and figures and landscape don't change, and must be understood as breaching our world then (our date 4 AD or BC or whatever), disclosing forms that neither change nor perish — which is in accord with what we know and believe about Christ already. The extraordinary thing is that if I am right, when the second coming —advent—takes place we will be at the first again with no real lapsed time; probably a theological theory could be made out of this insight. How could time pass in the real (eternal) world? Logically, it doesn't have linear time and the constant flux (change) which we have; one breaching followed by another at whatever our date may be would show no change there. The beast Rome, too, is a part of this landscape; here the judgment will be made. I keep discovering this: I did not see Rome back in our linear past but an archetypal eternal Rome, and everything else was outside linear time as well. I guess what I remembered is that we are really there (still), and never left, and the battle is decided there, the sides taken, and the judging done. What occurs to me now is the realization that upon the Parousia, everyone will all at once see this landscape, as the dokos lifts. They may hold relatively different positions; I believe I was with the small Xtian remnant. That doesn't mean everyone will be; the dokos or veil will roll back, and we will all be revealed in our actual positions in that goats-sheep struggle (sons of light vs sons of darkness). This is what the Day of Judgment will reveal. How we stand. Of course, to Him and to God we stand on that landscape already. Memory is not always of something past; I can remember what I must do tomorrow; I can remember who I am now. This was memory of what is, rather than what was; it has more significance than recollection of an event that took place long ago in history, like the Battle of Hastings. It had the reality of a living, enduring, present situation, as present as any other: on-going; the anticipation was so great, and preparations (against the tyranny) were in progress; this fits what the 3-eyed sibyl said, I think; pulling the regime down was a making way. No other explanation would account for my conviction that Rome is present now, in the dokos 1976 landscape which we see, under other names. Memory of a mere past event would not explain that. For example, what I saw as Roman police (ir leg) were present realities: the secret police; they were just seen under a different aspect; they were there anyhow, as the Enemy entrapping (as in TEARS; remember TEARS in this exegesis). This thoroughly reinforces my earlier conviction that what I experienced was an apocalyptic vision - i.e. of tha and timas. This Roman landscapa is another, and very important, aspect of that Parousia-vision; I have more reason to construe it as that, now, with this factored in. I.e. Rome as apocalyptic landscape, not past memory. To go back to another aspect: the fact that I judge the severity of my 3-74 situation and the evilness of the tyranny not sufficient alone to produce the general or personal intervention, that it seemed to me that the "St. Sophia" utterance was in answer to "Why?" — this and my view of Rome as actual landscape behind the dokos rather than memory of a past life of a past person: both point to the Parousia! By two indirect routes I again reach that conclusion! No matter how I approach it, we wind up with the same conclusion; but if we take different views of the meaning of 3-74, theory peters out. Rome as memory by an early Christian who died and was resurrected is the only alternate theory to Rome as apocalyptic background. Of course, there is the hardnosed their of suggestivity by the golden fish, but that wouldn't account for my knowledge of Koine Greek et al. That merely set it off; set off memory of Rome in the past? No, that Rome exists now; I am, rather than was, in Rome. Seeing the golden fish triggered off recognition of the true (concealed) reality situation; like the real meaning of the Bible, reality is stegenographic — concealed. The book the Bible is an analog of reality. • • Perhaps it can be said that I have seen the landscape slightly before the Parousia, since the presence is not there yet (the Xtians I saw were eagerly awaiting the Second Coming). But it is imminent. Yes, we are to prepare for it, as by overthrowing the tyranny; so it is minutes before the Parousia. Who prepares the way? Elijahl Elijah it was who came to me, maybe; he had been John the Baptist and so feared and hated the Romans! 74 was the time of preparing the way; the spirit that came to me was fiery and zealous. I did dream about Mt. Carmel, about Elisha, about Elias — 3 dreams. And it was Easter time, near Passover. And my spirit was a baptizing spirit...if I take into account what I never thought of, that Elijah returned as John the Baptist, well, the latter certainly was an early Christian, the first to recognize Jesus, and a baptizer, and killed by the Romans. And he comes a bit before the Parousia! That's why it had the distinct per¬ sonality of a fierce, earthly man, but also Xtian! Such a fighter — not mild nor meek. Earthy, a prophet. I knew it when I talked with Tom Disch; I'm sure of it now. But...could he also be the Holy Spirit? Elijah, who never died, who has seen heaven and hear the still small voice. The Bradbury program: Ahab vs Moby Dick; Elijah vs King Ahab. Me equals Moby Dick, I know from the sign I drew. I think this confirms it...and I think I have always had a part of Elijah's spirit, from birth: the changling on the raft. With Nixon as Ahab. * * Watching the "Depression" episode of Star Trek. "Adjustment Team." People, highly advanced, from the future, changing the past..."her death was meant to be but McCoy saved her." The HS I saw moving retrograde, and changing history. The "St. Sophia" statement is also important for a reason I hadn't realized: it means that what I saw —the overthrow of the tyranny— was not all that the supralunar forces intended, but that it was to be followed by another event, an even greater one: the return of the rightful King. So what I witnessed in 74 was not the totality but an initial part of a sequence. Had I not heard the "St. Sophia" statement I would reasonably compare what happened to the defeat of Egypt for the sake of the Israelites, and nothing more than that; mere intervention in history in the form of the removal of tyrants. The "St. Sophia" statement shows the comparison not to be correct (comparison to Egypt). Without the St. Sophia statement I would have misunderstood what I had been shown, basically misunderstood it. Now, if I take what I saw and was told by the sibyl, and what was done for me personally, and add the "St. Sophia" information, what do I arrive at instead? The Parousia. The throwing down of the tyranny in 74 is linked to the Parousia, and must be considered a forerunner, perhaps the stage of Elijah, a theory I favor repeatedly. Before the rightful King comes to claim his thrown, is it now logical that the ursurper is previously removed? Is that not step one? Would we not expect that? To see that happen first? "They killed all our leaders" - then God dispatched Elijah as our leader - he + holy widsom (The voice with whom Elijah spoke).
works_referenced: Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said
